summary:
## What is Dify?

Dify is a **free, open-source** platform designed for building and managing AI-powered applications. It allows you to create autonomous **AI agents** and **chatbots** by combining your chosen **LLM** (Large Language Model) with a variety of tools and a custom knowledge base. This makes it ideal for building specialized bots that can use private or confidential enterprise data.

## Building an AI Agent

The core of Dify is the **Studio**, where you build and configure your agents.

*   **Start with Templates**: You can quickly begin by using a pre-built template for common use cases like programming assistants, HR bots, or creative tools.
*   **Orchestration Panel**: This is the main workspace for defining your agent's behavior.
    *   **Instructions**: Write the main prompt and define the agent's task and personality.
    *   **Context**: Connect your agent to a **Knowledge Base** to provide it with specialized information.
    *   **Tools**: Integrate with external services like **OpenAI (DALL-E)** for image generation or **Vectorizer.ai** for converting images to SVG.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Dify itself does not have AI capabilities. You must connect it to an LLM provider (like OpenAI, Gemini, or Olama) and other tools by providing the necessary **API keys**.

## Custom Knowledge Base

A key feature of Dify is the ability to create a custom **Knowledge Base** to train your AI on specific data, moving beyond generic web knowledge.

*   **Data Import**: You can import data from various sources:
    *   Files like `.txt`, `.md`, `.pdf`, and `.html`.
    *   Sync directly from Notion.
    *   (Coming Soon) Sync from websites.
*   **Processing & Indexing**: Dify processes your documents into smaller, searchable chunks. It can automatically generate **question-and-answer pairs** from the text to improve retrieval accuracy.
*   **Retrieval Testing**: You can test how well your knowledge base works by asking questions and seeing which document segments it pulls from.

## Application Management & Deployment

Once your agent is built, Dify provides multiple ways to manage and share it.

*   **API Access**: Dify automatically generates **API endpoints** and documentation for every chatbot, allowing for easy integration into other applications.
*   **Logs & Analytics**: Review conversation histories to debug issues or see user interactions. You can **annotate** responses (mark as good or bad) to help the agent learn and improve over time. The platform also provides analytics on usage and token costs.
*   **Deployment Options**:
    *   **Fork a Standalone App**: Create a complete **Next.js** web application from your chatbot with a single click.
    *   **Embed on a Website**: Integrate the chatbot into an existing site using an **iFrame**, a **chat bubble script**, or as a **Chrome Extension**.

## Introduction to Dify

Start from one of the ready-to-use templates or create yours from scratch with the visual workflow editor.

Stand out from the generic AI bots using the knowledge base to make it become an expert in any field you want to train it for. Ideal for private and confidential enterprise data.

## Deployment Options & Elestio Setup

Before diving into the platform overview, let's see the different options available for us to use it. You can use the cloud version by clicking on the get started button. It contains a free tier perfect to grasp the potential of Dify. You can also self-host it by following their GitHub installation guide or use a platform like ours, Elestio, to take care of the installation, backups, updates, and maintenance for you on the cloud provider of your choice.

To install Dify on our platform, head to elest.io and click on login. Deploy my first service. Search for Dify and click on select. Choose between the different cloud provider, region, and service plan based on your need. I will choose two CPU and 4 GB of RAM and then next. Adjust your level of support. I will keep the free included one and then create service.

Once your instance is ready, you will receive an email. Follow the click here to get the password link. You arrive on your administration panel on Elestio. Copy the password to your clipboard and follow your instance link by following the admin UI here.
